2.204.25
StateIndicator.Style
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The StateIndicator.Style element specifies style information for a StateIndicator. The
StateIndicator.Style element is ignored in any schema version prior to RDL 2010/01. This element
is optional. This element is of type Style.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.Style element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
